columns.heading: No more spreadsheets
columns.desc: Automatic calculation replaces manual work. No formatting, no copying, no errors.

columns.heading: From estimate to invoice
columns.desc: One tool for the entire workflow — estimate, report, GST tax invoice and receipt.

columns.heading: 30–60 min. saved per job
columns.desc: Less paperwork, more repairs. The time savings pay off from day one.

columns.heading: Tamper-proof audit trail
columns.desc: SHA-256 hash chain, automatic document versions and PDF snapshots — full traceability for every invoice.

columns.heading: Accounting-ready exports
columns.desc: CSV and Excel exports for revenue, GST and open invoices — a clean handoff to your accountant.

columns.heading: Local data backup

cards.heading: Hail & dent estimation
cards.desc: Estimate hail damage per panel, per vehicle, by triage, or by the hour, with live calculation across every panel. Dent & parking damage: per panel, flat rate, or time-based.

cards.heading: Documents & GST invoices
cards.desc: Estimate, report, tax invoice and receipt — all as PDF with your logo and GST itemised. Plus credit notes, assignment declarations, free-form manual invoices and a one-click job-package ZIP.

cards.heading: Insurance direct workflow
cards.desc: Guided 4-step process: damage entry, assignment declaration with digital signature, send to insurer, automatic split invoice — including in-person customer approval.

cards.heading: Subcontractor workflow
cards.desc: Encrypted job transfer (AES-256), three compensation models with live split, dual-notify close-out, and duplicate-merge on re-import — complete audit trail between contractor and sub.

cards.heading: Analytics dashboard
cards.desc: Business intelligence at a glance: revenue & cashflow, receivables by due-date bucket, top customers, top insurers, payment duration and a conversion funnel — all in AUD.

cards.heading: Multi-device & local data
cards.desc: Sync the office PC, the workshop tablet and the accountant's PC through your own NAS or cloud — same data on every device. Shared-folder sync runs on Windows; Android tablets work standalone with the full feature set. Stays 100% local and offline — your data is yours.

groups.heading: Invoicing & payments
items: Manual invoices without a report — share the same invoice counter
GST tax invoices with your ABN, logo and itemised GST
Payment tracking with partial payments and shortfall display
Invoice status (Created → Delivered → Paid) updated automatically
Credit notes, split invoices, cancellation with replacement

groups.heading: Analytics & controlling
items: Revenue and cashflow charts over any custom time range
Receivables aged into buckets (0–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+ days)
Top customers, top insurers, avg. job value, avg. days to pay
Conversion funnel: Report → Accepted → Invoiced → Paid

groups.heading: Job package & documents
items: Job-package export — ZIP per job with report, invoice, assignment, photos, backup
Documents panel: attach any PDF to a job (assessment report, insurance confirmation…)
Email preview with multi-attachment picker across all job documents
In-person customer approval with digital signature on the device

groups.heading: Subcontractor workflow
items: Three compensation models: time rate, percentage, flat — with live split
Dual-notify close-out: both sub and contractor are informed automatically
Encrypted job transfer (AES-256) and sub-job import via the backup menu
Duplicate merge on re-import — no double entries

groups.heading: Photos & vehicle
items: QR-code mini server — upload photos straight from your phone into the job, no cable or login
Up to 12 photos per job with captions, integrated in the PDF report
Automatic compression in 3 quality levels, EXIF data (incl. GPS) is stripped
Damaged-parts selector L/R per panel with note

groups.heading: Multi-device & NAS sync
items: Run PDR Kalk on multiple devices — desktop in the office, tablet in the workshop, accountant from home
Shared-folder sync (NAS, OneDrive, Synology Drive) between your Windows devices — you control where your data lives
Android tablets run standalone with the full feature set — own local database, no shared-folder sync
Recommended for shared-folder sync: Windows PC, laptop or tablet 10" or larger — Android tablets (Android 10+) for standalone use only

groups.heading: Export, backup & accounting
items: CSV and Excel exports: revenue, GST and open receivables
Full backup as ZIP (with / without photos) locally on your device
Smart restore — no duplicates, photos are picked up automatically
Audit trail export as JSON with SHA-256 verification

groups.heading: Timeline, audit trail & email
items: Job timeline / history — unified case view across report ↔ invoice
SHA-256 hash chain — every entry cryptographically linked
Automatic document versions and PDF snapshots on every status change
Direct SMTP sending with IMAP filing and delivery tracking

groups.heading: Help & user manual
items: Extensive user manual built directly into the app — searchable by topic
Section-specific guides: dashboard, analytics, invoices, email, subcontractors, insurance…
Step-by-step workflows with notes and tips
Dedicated sections on audit-trail compliance and keyboard navigation

items.quote: As a PDR technician, PDR Kalk makes my work enormously easier. The software is clear, professionally structured and saves a lot of time every day when calculating hail and parking damage. I particularly appreciate the simple operation, the clean creation of reports and invoices, and the reliable calculations. You can tell immediately that it was developed by someone who knows the PDR trade from hands-on experience. Support is fast and competent. A clear recommendation for anyone who wants to work professionally and efficiently.
items.name: Florian Huber

items.quote: In my view, PDR Kalk is the best hail and parking damage calculation software on the market. It impresses with extremely simple, intuitive operation and is available for both Windows and Android — ideal for flexible use in the office and on the road. Calculations can be created quickly and clearly, sent digitally straight away and seamlessly converted into invoices. A particular strength is the ability to cleanly divide work and let several technicians work together as subcontractors in one system, keeping full transparency over services, billing and responsibilities at all times. PDR Kalk saves an enormous amount of time, reduces errors and ensures a professional, structured workflow — from damage assessment to billing. For hail and parking damage businesses it's a real asset and hard to work without. A clear recommendation.
items.name: Jürg Strähl

items.quote: This professional calculation app helps businesses estimate parking and hail damage on vehicles quickly, precisely and without fuss. It impresses with its particularly simple operation and enables efficient damage capture. Stored lists of various insurers make processing even easier and ensure a structured, practical workflow. Thanks to pre-stored items, calculations can be created quickly and tailored individually, and you can add your own notes for special requirements. The result is a mature, professional product that reliably and effectively supports digital damage calculation.
items.name: Sandro Sciuto

items.quote: Very good app with simple, clear operation. The functions are well thought out and make daily work noticeably easier. I find the ability to work with subcontractors and team members particularly practical. All in all, a reliable and professional solution. A clear recommendation!
items.name: Dominik Nagy
